title: Weirdly Sized for the Labels.
text: Weirdly Sized for the Labels.. I don’t understand these containers at all. The garlic one is appropriately sized for holding quite a lot of garlic. The others are terribly tiny for what they are supposed to hold. I can fit maybe 3 or 4 baking potatoes in the potato can. I can fit about 5 onions in the onion can. That is not nearly big enough for storage purposes. I also found the font a bit weird. Bleeding Cowboy font just looks weird on these in person. The containers themselves are fine. The lids fit well. They seem well made. The size is just really off. I mean, I guess if you’re a single person, storage for 4 potatoes may be enough for you. I don’t know your life. But for my family, it just doesn’t work.
